As truck body builder, you will work in the bodywork department, helping to build brand-new trucks from start to finish. You may also carry out repairs for existing customers. In many cases, you and your team will have built the entire vehicle yourselves. Working from technical drawings, you will build complete trucks together with your colleagues. Seeing the reaction of a customer when they collect their finished truck is extremely rewarding!

You are focussed on details and strive for precision and perfection. Together, you aim to deliver every truck to the highest possible standard.

Don't worry if you don't have any experience yet. If you are motivated to learn and enjoy contributing to a beautiful finished product, we encourage you to apply immediately!

- You speak Dutch and/or English
- You are willing to attend training courses and develop your skills
- You are practical and enjoy working with your hands
- You have an interest in technology and technical work
